label: Focus in Class
intro: Low levels of certain B vitamins can affect brain function and attention. During busy school days, this can make it harder to concentrate, stay sharp, or process new info.
bullets:
🧠 Vitamin B1 supports brain signaling and memory.

🪄 Vitamin B2 helps maintain healthy nerve function.

🧬 Vitamin B6 plays a role in neurotransmitter production.

label: Boosted Energy
intro: When key vitamins like B6 or B12 run low, your teen's cells can’t make enough energy — leading to tiredness, brain fog, or feeling “off.” It’s common during growth, late nights, or busy school days.
bullets:
⚡️ Vitamin B6 helps convert food into fuel.

🩸 Vitamin B12 supports red blood cells that carry oxygen.

🍊 Vitamin C boosts iron absorption and energy metabolism.

label: Balanced Moods
intro: Vitamin deficiencies can throw off the brain’s natural mood regulators, making teens feel irritable, anxious, or just not like themselves.
bullets:
🧠 Vitamin B6 — supports serotonin and dopamine production

💭 Vitamin B12 helps regulate mood and nervous system function

🌿 Magnesium promotes calm and emotional balance

label: Clear Skin
intro: Teen breakouts can be triggered by hormonal changes and nutrient gaps. Especially when skin-supporting vitamins like A and C are running low.
bullets:
🍑 Vitamin A supports healthy skin cell turnover

🍊 Vitamin C helps with collagen production and healing

🛡️ Zinc fights inflammation and supports clear skin
